Team —

We're green-lit to run a full courier + signer simulation for Acme's sterile site on Sept 10 (window: 09:00–15:00 PT). Purpose: validate physical-media handoff, signer chain-of-custody, on-site operator acceptance, and post-deploy audit ingestion. This is a dress rehearsal — no images will be activated.

Attached: sim-runbook-v1.md (draft). Key asks before I lock the runbook:
- Ops: confirm courier ingress/egress constraints and insurance/custody docs (Connor).
- Signing: confirm KMS wrapping step and offline-key-holder roster (Karthik).
- CS/Customer: confirm Acme's on-site receiver name and badging process (Acme infra).
- Training: arrange a 30-min operator briefing for the receiving crew on Sept 9.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) Sept 9 — operator briefing + sign-off (recording created).
2) Sept 10 — courier handoff simulation (no activation).
3) Sept 11 — post-sim evidence package delivered to Acme security bucket and to our audit log.

Please review the runbook and reply with changes by EOD Sep 4 so I can circulate to Acme and IronCourier.

Thanks,
Hannah

- Windows: Sept 10 is OK, but IronCourier needs a firm 3-hour arrival window to avoid operator overlap. Suggest 10:00–13:00 local.

If we lock these, I'll update the runbook and generate the short operator-briefing slides (operator-briefing-slides.pdf).
